blocked_by: M2256 classifies midcourse mild boundary containment regression

M2257 must audit global timing severity clearance and profile_seed deltas

M2257 must not run reset rollout measured execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID claims

stop_condition: stop if M2256 artifacts are incomplete

stop if audit recommends reward tweaking without route support
fallback_plan: route to midcourse corridor-containment repair design if slice support holds
route to collision guardrail repair if L3 local collision is primary
route to branch synthesis or stop if no repair is justified

M2256 severity delta is mild +11 and severe 0

one follow-up manifest selected by the audit

allowed_claims: no controller ranking paper-level result finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion or level3 self-identification claim

midcourse mild boundary-containment regression is audited
guardrails remain false for reset rollout training ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims
